speaker: Speakers are requested to adhere to the time allotted for their presentation as indicated in the program schedule.
Open with a title slide listing the presentation title, speaker name and affiliation, followed by a brief self-introduction.
Use clear, concise content with bullet points and visuals; tables and graphs should be easily readable.
Send presentation slides to the program manager at least one month before the conference and bring a flash-drive backup.
Submit presentations in 16:9 PPT or PDF format. Ensure visuals are highly legible.
Slight program changes may occur — please be present in the room from the start of your session day.
Follow time cues from session chairs, maintain professionalism and engage in Q&A.
For any support, reach out to the speaker coordinator via the conference email.
poster: Posters should measure 36" × 48" (3 × 4 ft). Confirm dimensions with organizers before printing.
Text should be readable from 3–4 feet — body 24 pt, headings 36–48 pt, sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica).
Use a contrasting colour scheme and adequate spacing for clarity.
Use high-resolution images and well-aligned graphics.
On-site printing is not available — arrange printing in advance.
Presenters should remain at their poster throughout the assigned poster session.
Collect your poster by end of day; uncollected posters will be disposed of.
participant: All participants must pre-register online; on-site registration is available at standard rates.
Wear your conference badge at all times within the venue.
Engage actively in sessions — ask questions, contribute to discussions, respect speakers and fellow delegates.
Embrace diversity and an inclusive environment. Harassment of any kind will not be tolerated.
Use breaks, meals and networking sessions to exchange ideas and build relationships.
In case of emergency, follow venue staff instructions and familiarize yourself with the exits.

terms: By registering for GCPR 2027, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions.

While we strive to follow the published schedule, unforeseen circumstances may necessitate alterations.
The organizer may cancel the conference due to unavoidable circumstances; in that event, the organizer's liability is limited as set out in the cancellation policy.
If the conference is postponed for reasons beyond the organizer's control, registrations remain valid for the rescheduled event or future editions; refund policy may not apply.
Cancellation notices will be communicated through reasonable means, including the conference website.
Delegates are responsible for checking the website regularly for updates.
We do not accept liability for personal injuries or loss/damage to personal property occurring during the event.
By attending, you acknowledge and agree to these terms.
privacy: We collect only the information you submit through the registration, abstract submission, sponsorship and contact forms.
Your information is used solely to administer your participation, communicate program updates and process payments.
We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
Anonymous, aggregated analytics may be used to improve the website and the conference.
Where required by law, we will respond to data access, correction and deletion requests submitted to the conference email.
Payments are processed by PCI-compliant third-party providers; we do not store full card details on our servers.

faq.a: Physical Medicine researchers, clinicians, industry professionals, government officials, entrepreneurs and students working on physical medicine.

faq.q: How can I register for the conference?
faq.a: Visit the Register page on this site and follow the instructions. Early-bird discounts apply through October 30, 2026.

faq.q: Does the registration fee include hotel accommodation?
faq.a: No — accommodation is a separate optional add-on at registration. Hotel rates are listed on the Registration Details page.
Yes — three or more delegates from the same institution receive 10% off each registration. Contact us for larger groups.

faq.q: Will the organizer fund my travel or accommodation?
faq.a: We do not provide travel or accommodation funding, but registered participants receive substantial discounts and an invitation letter for visa purposes.

faq.q: Can I get a letter of invitation for visa purposes?
faq.a: Yes — invitation letters are issued to registered participants only. Please complete your registration first.

faq.q: How many abstracts can I submit?
faq.a: Up to two abstracts per author. See the Submit Abstract page for guidelines.

faq.q: What is the abstract submission deadline?
faq.a: December 20, 2026 for full consideration. Late submissions are reviewed subject to space.
